name: Chao ca ngheo
summary: Cháo cá nghéo is a porridge at Đá Nhảy, under the Lý Hòa pass, not a Đồng Hới market bowl. Du khách, the Quảng Trị visitor desk, says cá nghéo is a local cartilaginous fish with lean meat and rough skin, and that it bears live young.
origin: Đá Nhảy. Du khách on 7 Dec 2015, republishing Đại đoàn kết. One feature story.
howToEat: The 7 Dec 2015 article finishes the porridge with oyster mushroom, straw mushroom, and button mushroom, over finely cut green mustard, with Đồng Hới fish sauce and hot chili.
The story places the bowl at lunch, at Đá Nhảy under the Lý Hòa pass.
where: Đá Nhảy, under the Lý Hòa pass. Not Chợ Đồng Hới.
seoTitle: Chao ca ngheo at Da Nhay
seoDescription: Cháo cá nghéo is a mushroom porridge of a lean, rough-skinned fish at Đá Nhảy, under the Lý Hòa pass.
